## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 1f1b516171664d26669bc59009aefd81aaa76a17

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** The fix in `df2beb076` wraps a `for (CourseOffering course: io.getCourseOfferings())` loop that calls `section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), c.getClassSuffix(course))`, adding a null-check on the suffix before calling `setName`. I used `git log -p -S"section.setName(course.getUniqueId()"` on the file to find every commit that added or removed this exact line. It appeared in exactly one commit (added, never modified until the fix), and `git log -S` confirms this string's occurrence count changed exactly twice — once when introduced, once when fixed.

**(2) Specific change:** Commit `1f1b51617` (Jun 20, 2017) introduced this loop:
```java
for (CourseOffering course: io.getCourseOfferings())
    section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), c.getClassSuffix(course));
```
It calls `c.getClassSuffix(course)` unconditionally and passes the result straight into `section.setName(...)` without checking for `null`. The very next line above it (unchanged, pre-existing code) already demonstrates that `getClassSuffix()` can return `null`:
```java
(c.getExternalUniqueId() == null ? c.getClassSuffix() == null ? c.getSectionNumberString() : c.getClassSuffix() : c.getExternalUniqueId())
```
This shows the author was aware `getClassSuffix()`/`getClassSuffix(course)` can be null in general, but the new loop added in `1f1b51617` neglected that null-check, allowing a `null` name to be stored via `setName` for a course/section pairing — the exact defect fixed in `df2beb076` by adding `if (suffix != null) section.setName(...)`.

**(3) Evidence:** 
- `git log -S"section.setName(course.getUniqueId()"` shows the string was introduced exactly once, in `1f1b51617`, and never touched again until the fix commit `df2beb076`.
- `Class_.java:1672-1673` confirms `getClassSuffix(CourseOffering)` delegates to `getExternalClassNameHelper().getClassSuffix(...)`, an external/pluggable helper whose implementation can legitimately return `null` (consistent with the null-check seen elsewhere in the same method for the no-argument `getClassSuffix()`).
- The `setName(Long, String)` method itself lives in the external `cpsolver` library (found in `WebContent/WEB-INF/lib/cpsolver-1.3.109.jar`, not in this repo's source), so it wasn't in scope to fix there — the correct fix, and the one applied, is to guard against `null` at the call site, exactly where `1f1b51617` first introduced the unguarded call.

I'm confident in this identification since the diff context of the fix is a near-exact match (line-for-line) with the code added in `1f1b51617`, with no intervening modifications to that logic.
